Re: Appeal of adverse benefit determination  
Member: Quinn Novak  
Member ID: W763701748  
Reference number: POC-7321626800-52420  
Requested service: Total shoulder replacement  
CPT: 23472  
Date of denial notice: August 2, 2026

To the Appeals Department:

I request reversal of the denial and authorization of the requested total shoulder replacement, CPT 23472. The denial states that the submitted records did not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment. The prior authorization packet does document extensive conservative treatment, together with persistent symptoms, objective disease, and substantial functional impairment.

The records establish the following:

- Quinn has had 14 months of progressive shoulder pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- Quinn used NSAIDs for four months, with inadequate relief.
- Quinn received a corticosteroid injection on April 9, 2026. It produced only two weeks of partial relief.
- Quinn completed 16 weeks of supervised physical therapy from March 14, 2026, through July 4, 2026. The therapy included range-of-motion work and periscapular strengthening, with 18 visits documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- Despite these measures, Quinn cannot reach overhead, dress without assistance, or sleep on the affected side.
- Examination showed glenohumeral crepitus, active forward elevation limited to 90 degrees, and external rotation limited to 10 degrees. Cuff strength remained intact.
- May 27, 2026 radiographs showed complete loss of the glenohumeral joint space, osteophytes, subchondral sclerosis, and a flattened glenoid. CT confirmed an intact rotator cuff.
- The record documents no active infection, no untreated substance use, BMI 29, and no smoking.

These records demonstrate that nonoperative treatment was attempted for a substantial period and included supervised physical therapy, medication, and injection treatment. The treatment provided inadequate or only temporary relief. Quinn continues to have severe pain, marked loss of motion, and major limitations in basic daily activities. The imaging and examination also provide objective support for the requested shoulder replacement.

Please overturn the denial and approve CPT 23472. If the plan maintains the denial, please provide a complete written explanation identifying the specific conservative-treatment requirement that the plan believes remains unmet and identifying every record relied upon in making that determination.

The denial notice does not identify the governing medical policy, policy number, effective date, or the precise clinical-review criteria applied. The plan has not provided a publicly identifiable policy that can be quoted here. Please therefore provide the exact policy and criteria used for this decision, including any proprietary clinical criteria, the applicable version or effective date, and the specific documentation required to demonstrate an adequate conservative-treatment trial.

Please acknowledge receipt of this appeal and provide the appeal decision in writing. The notice states that the appeal must be received by January 29, 2027.

Sincerely,

Quinn Novak  
Member ID: W763701748  
[Mailing address]  
[Telephone number]  
[Email address, if applicable]
